title: Automated Job Openings Platform
description: Full-stack platform that scrapes job postings from company career pages using configurable templates, stores data in PostgreSQL, and serves it through a mobile-first React web app with filtering by experience level and role.
highlights: Configurable scraping templates across multiple career pages
Automated pipelines storing data in Supabase PostgreSQL
Mobile-first React UI deployed on Vercel

title: Audio Metadata Visualization Tool
description: Svelte web app to visualize audio metadata from diverse input formats via interactive plots, designed for non-technical users with user-friendly filtering and dynamic graphs.
highlights: Interactive plots for audio metadata exploration
Robust input handling for diverse file formats

title: Wordle Clone
description: Recreated the Wordle game from scratch with custom logic, responsive design, and real-time feedback.

title: Food Delivery Microservice
description: User management microservice in Java for a food delivery platform, applying design patterns and layered architecture for modularity and maintainability.
